findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify custom pixel x7; Shopify app: Meta (Facebook & Instagram) x7. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: 1 tracking script(s) held until consent
findings.detail: Parked as non-executable until the CMP grants consent: Shopify CDN (ignore).
findings.recommendation: Positive if intentional; make sure the banner is actually shown to the visitors it applies to, otherwise these tags never fire.

findings.title: Ad pixels fire on load (no banner shown to this visitor)
findings.detail: Consentmo is present but showed no banner to this US visitor; Campaign Manager 360 / Floodlight, Criteo, Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Pixel fired on load — consistent with a US opt-out model.
findings.recommendation: Confirm EU/UK visitors get an opt-in banner and US opt-out (Do Not Sell / GPC) suppresses these pixels.

findings.title: Needs attention: Meta — Single Meta pixel
findings.detail: 2 Meta pixels receive data: 181579185960224, 197085518345990. Why it matters: Extra IDs split audiences and send customer data to accounts nobody watches.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.

findings.title: Needs attention: Stack — Third-party request volume
findings.detail: 1511 third-party requests across the visit (18 identified platforms). Why it matters: Tag weight slows pages, which costs conversion rate.
findings.recommendation: Audit apps/pixels that don't earn their weight.

analyst_checklist.item: Visit from an EU/UK VPN: does a banner appear, and do ad pixels wait for consent?

analyst_checklist.item: Check the footer for a 'Your Privacy Choices / Do Not Sell or Share' link (none found on the homepage HTML)
Do GA4 revenue and Google Ads / Meta purchase counts reconcile with Shopify orders (a gap above ~10% usually means a tracking problem)?
Meta are fed by more than one route (Meta: Shopify app, Shopify custom pixel). Who manages each, and which one is meant to be the source of truth?
Are all of these Meta pixels still in use (any agency or legacy accounts)? 181579185960224, 197085518345990.
Is the Facebook & Instagram app's data sharing set to 'Maximum' (Conversions API on), and what Event Match Quality do Purchase events get?
Which conversion action is primary for purchases — the Google & YouTube app, a GTM tag or a GA4 import — and is enhanced conversions on?
Do you sell into the EU/UK or Quebec, and how is consent handled for those visitors?
